note: Independent re-judgment at HEAD (audit-b). RFC 8277 Section 2.5: "If I1 is the same as I2, UPDATE U2 MUST be interpreted as meaning that L2 is now bound to P at N1 and that L1 is no longer bound to P at N1. UPDATE U1 is implicitly withdrawn." TestRFC8277AddPathSameNextHopKeepsIndependentLabels, TestLabeledImplicitWithdrawalAddPath, and TestRFC8277AddPathLabelsBoundPerPath prove re-advertising the same Path Identifier at the same next hop N1 replaces the path's label alone without adding a route, while a different Path Identifier adds a separate path and leaves the earlier route and label intact.
